task.pr_title: Fix  get_asset_paths not properly deleting empty folders (& recursive async functions)

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
Based on [the description of `&&`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/reference/expressions/operator-expr.html#lazy-boolean-operators), it actually serves no purpose beyond a normal `&` in this instance, therefore the `&=` operator can be used instead, simplifying the expression without any change. This will also avoid the unintended consequence of not evaluating `get_asset_paths` if the order of the `&&` operands were reversed.

More importantly, I think it's actually _wrong_. I believe the intent was to use logical OR, since (I believe) this `get_asset_paths` function is supposed to return `true` if _any_ sub-folder contains a file, but right now it will only do so if _every_ folder does, which doesn't seem right to me.

I believe this is why line 536 has a comment suppressing the error likely being returned by `remove_empty_directory`.

So, with _all_ that context, here's my suggestion:

```suggestion
                    contains_files |= Box::pin(get_asset_paths(
                        reader,
                        clean_empty_folders_writer,
                        child_path,
                        paths,
                    ))
                    .await?;
```

evidence.thread_resolution:
ArthurBrussee: Ohh nice catch! Yeah I think it's definitely meant to be an or. 

I've made this change here now, but let me know if that's better as a seperate PR.
